text.en:
Today you learn to say what already happened.
I walked home yesterday.
It means: I got home on foot, and it is done.
She called a taxi.
It means: she phoned for a car, and it is done.

Add ed to the end of the word.
wash, washed: He washed the cups.
If the word already ends in e, add only d: arrive, arrived.
The train arrived ten minutes late.
Some words double the last letter: stop, stopped.
The driver stopped by the gate.
If the word ends in y, the y becomes i: try, tried.
We tried a different cable.

You will say what people did, ask, and say they did not.
To ask, start with Did.
To say no, use did not.
After Did and did not, the word is short again.
Did the bus arrive on time?
They did not miss the flight.
